title: Lightly Crispy Chinese Corn Scallion Pancake
description: A crispy and savory Chinese dish featuring a corn arepa filled with mozzarella cheese, wrapped in a pandan leaf and served as a scallion pancake. This low-carb friendly dish is a crowd-pleaser.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together cornmeal, salt, and pepper.
Add beaten eggs to the bowl and stir until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes pliable.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a quarter cup of shredded mozzarella cheese in the center.
Fold the dough over the cheese to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes on each side until crispy and golden brown.
Wrap each pancake in a pandan leaf and serve immediately.
Shock the cooked pancakes in an ice bath to stop the cooking process.
Pat the pancakes dry with paper towels before serving.

axes.primaryIngredient: corn arepa filled with mozarella cheese
